description: Ministry of Defence - Regulation made to amend the Fifth Schedule to the Explosive Ordinance that related to Fees for the Licenses and Permits published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1133/13 of 24.05.2000
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Explosive Ordinance, specifically amending the fee schedule for licenses and permits related to explosives. It involves legal/regulatory matters including statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While it mentions the President/Minister of Defence making the regulation, this is in his official capacity to establish legal framework rather than being primarily about government personnel or structure.
